NAME

YAML::PP::Writer::File - Write YAML output to file or file handle

SYNOPSIS

    my $writer = YAML::PP::Writer::File->new(output => $file);

DESCRIPTION

The YAML::PP::Emitter sends its output to the writer.

You can use your own writer. if you want to send the YAML output to somewhere else. See t/44.writer.t for an example.

METHODS

new
    my $writer = YAML::PP::Writer::File->new(output => $file);
    my $writer = YAML::PP::Writer::File->new(output => $filehandle);

Constructor.

write
    $writer->write('- ');
init
    $writer->init;

Initialize

finish
    $writer->finish;

Gets called when the output ends. If The argument was a filename, the filehandle will be closed. If the argument was a filehandle, the caller needs to close it.

output, set_output
Getter/setter for the YAML output
